action_plan.summary: PR #4066 (author flipch) is a real, correctly-diagnosed bug fix -- gt prime --hook never resolved extends/compose in formulas (zero steps rendered for wc26-* style formulas) and {{issue}} substitution was missing on the standalone-formula-sling path -- but its own diff is stale and CI-failing and cannot merge as-is. A prior Sheriff pass (bead gt-pvy7, 2026-07-08/09) opened replacement PR #4445, which independently verified and re-implemented the same fix, but is now itself stale/CONFLICTING against current main (6 weeks untouched) and its sole commit ('WIP: checkpoint (auto)') carries no real attribution trailer despite the PR body's claim. This pass independently re-derived both bugs from first principles against a fresh upstream/main (649b832b7): bug 1 (formula.Resolve never called in resolveFormulaForRendering, the current single choke point feeding all three step-rendering call sites) is confirmed still present; bug 2 is confirmed ALREADY FIXED on current main for the bond-to-base-bead sling paths (sling.go, sling_dispatch.go) via an unrelated refactor (formulaVarsForBead unconditionally prepends issue=<beadID>), but still present for the standalone-formula-sling path (sling_formula.go). Implemented a minimal fix restricted to exactly these two remaining gaps: one line calling the pre-existing formula.Resolve() at the shared rendering choke point (no new exported API, smaller/more converged than #4445's approach of adding a new formula.ResolveFormula() wrapper), and one line prepending issue=<wispRootID> in sling_formula.go. Verified via 5 independent pre-implementation review legs (2 initial objections resolved with concrete evidence: embedded formulas are tried first inside formula.Resolve's own loadFormulaByName, so the 2-path on-disk formulaSearchPaths helper is sufficient; formula.Parse() already calls Validate() so Resolve()'s no-op re-validate on non-extends formulas cannot newly reject anything) and 5 independent post-implementation review legs (all CONFIRM) against the final PR #4725 head. Opened fresh replacement PR #4725 from current upstream/main with genuine Co-authored-by attribution to flipch. Commented on stale #4445 recommending maintainer closure as superseded-by-defect (lacked permission to close it directly). Left original #4066 open/untouched per the do-not-unilaterally-close-contributor-PRs policy, recommending a maintainer close it once #4725 merges. No refinery/MQ route used for the #4066 disposition.

research_legs.lens: formula.Resolve() existence and callers on current upstream/main
research_legs.summary: Fresh git fetch upstream main (649b832b7). internal/formula/parser.go exports func Resolve(formula *Formula, searchPaths []string) (*Formula, error) (line 508) -- full extends+compose merge, cycle detection, own package tests. git grep for 'formula.Resolve(' across internal/cmd/ on upstream/main: zero callers. Bug 1 confirmed still present.

internal/cmd/prime_molecule.go's resolveFormulaForRendering is now the SINGLE shared helper feeding showFormulaSteps, showFormulaStepsFull, AND renderFormulaRootAndStepsFull (consolidated since #4066/#4445 were written, when there were 2 separate call sites). Confirmed exact missing call site: ResolveFormulaContent -> Parse -> [missing Resolve] -> applyFormulaOverlays -> return.

Both already overwrite local vars-for-attachment with result.FormulaVars returned from InstantiateFormulaOnBead -> formulaVarsForBead, which unconditionally prepends issue=<beadID> before appending caller vars. This part of #4066's original diff is superseded/moot on current main via an independent refactor; confirmed by reading both files directly.

Standalone-formula-sling path: fieldUpdates.Vars/FormulaVars built from raw slingVars with no issue=<wispRootID> prepended, even though wispRootID is already known at that point in the function. Real, narrow, still-present gap -- confirmed by reading the function in full.

internal/cmd/prime.go calls showFormulaStepsFull(attachment.AttachedFormula, ..., attachmentFormulaVars(attachment)); attachmentFormulaVars() merges attachment.FormulaVars + attachment.AttachedVars (both bead-stored fields) into the extraVars fed to rendering. Confirms the bead-field storage location (not bd's own wisp bond vars) is exactly what gt prime reads -- validates R12's fix target.

research_legs.lens: formula.Resolve() no-op safety for non-extends formulas
research_legs.summary: internal/formula/parser.go's resolveChain: when len(formula.Extends)==0 && formula.Compose==nil, short-circuits to Validate()-and-return-unchanged (first branch, before any extends/compose logic runs). formula.Parse() (line 23) already calls f.Validate() before returning. Confirmed: for the majority of formulas with no extends/compose (e.g. mol-polecat-work, the formula this very review bead runs under), calling Resolve() after Parse() is a provably idempotent no-op re-check -- cannot newly reject anything Parse() already accepted.

internal/formula/parser.go's loadFormulaByName (used by Resolve() to load extends parents and compose.expand targets): tries the embedded formula FS FIRST, then falls back to searchPaths. Confirms the 2-tier (rig, town) formulaSearchPaths helper is a sufficient fallback list -- embedded formulas (including any wc26-* parent/expansion formula that ships embedded rather than on-disk) are already covered inside Resolve() itself, independent of what searchPaths contains.

gh issue list search across 'formula extends compose', 'prime --hook steps', 'wc26' plus a body-text re-scan of #4066/#4445: found issue #3322 ('gt prime showFormulaStepsFull only reads embedded formulas'), a DIFFERENT bug (missing disk-fallback tier in an older code path) -- confirmed via internal/formula/embed.go's current ResolveFormulaContent to be ALREADY FIXED on current main (rig->town->embedded 3-tier resolution present), unrelated to #4066's remaining bug. No issue references #4066 by number in any PR body. No other candidate issues found.

pre_implementation_reviews.summary: Initial objection: formulaSearchPaths omits an embedded tier, risking failure to resolve an embedded-only extends parent. Resolved by R15: loadFormulaByName (used internally by Resolve()) already tries the embedded FS first, independent of searchPaths -- the 2-tier on-disk helper is a correct, sufficient fallback, matching the original PR author's own code comment making the same point.

Reuses the pre-existing formula.Resolve() directly (no new exported API, unlike #4445's ResolveFormula() wrapper); single choke-point fix covers all 3 rendering call sites; explicitly and correctly excludes sling.go/sling_dispatch.go as already-fixed to avoid churn; no new files/types.

Initial objection: does formula.Resolve()'s no-op branch's Validate() call risk rejecting a formula that currently passes Parse() but would fail Validate()? Resolved by R14: Parse() already calls Validate() unconditionally before returning -- the no-op branch's re-validate on an already-validated, unchanged struct is a provably safe idempotent check, not a new failure mode, for the majority of formulas with no extends/compose.

Objection: plan said nothing about disposing of #4445 itself (a Sheriff-authored artifact, not a contributor PR, so within Sheriff's authority to close/correct), leaving a misattributed/broken PR live. Incorporated: added an explicit step to comment on #4445 recommending closure as superseded-by-defect (attempted direct close, blocked by lack of write permission -- recorded honestly, not worked around).
